notes: The author's answer settles the genre boundary directly — free roleplay in an office setting rather than assigned desk jobs — so this is Roleplay & Avatar Sim and not Simulation's Role Sim, and nothing else mixes in. Shape is interior-single because the author chose one office floor over a building with lifts: the floor is the entire map, the player never steps outside, and that also means there is no exterior to transition to, so this stays P0 with no P3 and no stacked-floor P2. Took the Morph Roleplay preset because it is the fixed pre-built space with no personal property at all, swapping its settlement-static shape for interior-single while keeping all three options bent to an office — social-hub as the open-plan floor and break area sized for a crowd, vignette-photo as the boardroom and reception backdrops roleplay actually happens against, landmark-focal as the branded 'officiial rolox hq' sign wall that carries the one name the prompt insists on. Added path-street for the corridors between desk banks and district-zoned to separate the loud open-plan desks from the quiet meeting rooms, and deliberately left trigger-task out because the author ruled out assigned tasks.
